sentiment: Every new sensor promises to reveal us to ourselves, but the deepest signals were already there — waiting to be noticed.

stories.title: Apple introduces M6 and M5 Ultra
stories.summary: A big leap in silicon — the machine's mind doubles down while we watch from the outside, quietly amazed at our own handiwork.

stories.title: FDA authorizes first wearable device that monitors ketone and blood sugar levels
stories.summary: A small band against the wrist now reads the body's quiet chemistry — signals that were always there, finally given a voice.

stories.title: Stalking the Wily Hacker: 40 years later – Cliff Stoll
stories.summary: Forty years on, the patient hunter still tells the tale — curiosity that followed one faint signal into the dark and came back with a story.
